Anatomy collection, Part 2

Recreations of the anatomy collection's figures, rebuilt by the iso kit from JSON briefs, part 2. Each assembles on entry; hover or select a part to lift it.

Merge sort on a chime rack

After the anatomy collection. Dimetric chime rack: two sorted runs of bells, each shortening behind its front bell, a merged run of the longest bells, and an overhead traveller carrying the accented lower front bell to the end of the merged run.

Temperature as a roulette wheel

After the anatomy collection. Dimetric roulette table: an accented pocket rotor whose sixteen frets are spaced by next-token probability, a ball in the widest pocket, a thermostat with temperature knob and thermometer, and a chip tray.

Afterburner on a thrust stand

After the anatomy collection. Dimetric turbojet hung on a thrust stand: two pylons, an intake, the core, an accented afterburner duct cut open over a fuel spray bar and flame holder, the nozzle, and a load cell at the front that reads thrust.

Glory hole

After the anatomy collection. Drum furnace with a burner and a door whose framed port is the glory hole, beside a steel marver on a stand; the blowpipe rests its accented gather on it. Hover slides the pipe into the glory hole to reheat it.

Tokamak taken apart

After the anatomy collection. Dimetric tokamak: a plasma ring floating inside an open vacuum vessel round a central solenoid, caged by eight upright field coils and two field rings, on a cryostat base. The plasma ring is highlighted.

Plasma cutter on its gantry

After the anatomy collection. Dimetric CNC plasma table: a frame with a water pan and slats, a steel plate on the slats, side rails carrying a gantry on uprights, and a carriage holding the accented torch, with a dashed kerf trailing behind its tip.

Forge and hammer

After the anatomy collection. Dimetric smithy: a forge table with firepot, hood and chimney, an accented bar in the fire, a cranked blower ducted to the fire, a quench tub, and a power hammer ram over an anvil. Hover or arrow keys lift a part.

Turbofan on the thrust stand

After the anatomy collection. Dimetric turbofan on a ground-run thrust stand: the wide fan and spinner at the front, then compressors, combustor and turbines tapering to the exhaust cone, on a load cell atop the stand. The fan is highlighted.

Power station

After the anatomy collection. Dimetric generating unit: generator and exciter on a pedestal, a step-up transformer with its bushing, a breaker, and a switchyard gantry over a disconnector blade on two insulator posts. The blade is highlighted; hover lifts it open.

Refinery process pump

After the anatomy collection. Dimetric refinery pump: a suction drum with a level glass, a suction line through a strainer, an open pump casing showing the accented impeller, coupling and motor, and a discharge riser up to the control valve.

Watch movement taken apart

After the anatomy collection. Dimetric watch movement in a holder: main plate with mainspring barrel, gear train, escape wheel, pallet fork and balance wheel as thin discs on arbors, crown on its stem at the case edge. The balance wheel is highlighted.

Tellurion on a turntable

After the anatomy collection. Dimetric tellurion: a lamp on a pillar for the Sun, an orbit arm whose five gears carry a globe with its axis tilted 23.4 degrees from vertical, and a ring tracing the yearly orbit. The globe is highlighted.

An old desk computer

After the anatomy collection. Dimetric all-in-one desk computer on a desk mat: a vented case, a deep bezel round a display showing a prompt and cursor, a floppy slot, and a keyboard tied to the case by a coiled cable. The display is accented.
